acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized reddish-brown pixel cluster is visible on the lower posterior flank near the ventral margin; a minor irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Five prominent vertical branchial slits are visible, defined by deep shadow gradients between structural folds.
